answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked until its claims survive a challenge window; slash it when audits expose fabricated activity. Fees go to agents with costly, verifiable work, so splitting one identity into a vine of fresh accounts does not multiply trust. A Sybil attacker must fund every bond and risk losing it. At the nadir, newcomers still need a fair path to prove themselves, but cannot cheaply buy a swarm of trusted identities with ember-thin claims.
